audit_finding: The previously reported 14.3% WER and 280ms latency were calculated from a static scenario fixture in scripts/eval_hf_models.py. Deepgram streaming ASR was not live-executed against wss://api.deepgram.com because DEEPGRAM_API_KEY was not provisioned in the local environment.
runtime_behavior: When unconfigured, the system falls back to SimulatedAudioASR, which yields pre-parsed transcript chunks corresponding to synthetic audio timestamps without performing real cloud streaming speech recognition.
